name: Kōkamonin no Bettō
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 88); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 12th century.

poems.title: I’ve seen thee but a few short hours
poems.author: Kōkamonin no Bettō
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 88

poems.title: 88. 難波江の あしのかりねの 一夜ゆゑ (Naniwae no ashi no karine no hitoyo yue)
poems.author: Kōkamonin no Bettō
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 千載集
poems.text:
難波江の あしのかりねの 一夜ゆゑ
みをつくしてや 戀ひわたるべき
